title: Watched Spoorloos last night and can't understand that scene with the teacher

commenti.body: From what I remember, it's his first real attempt, and she doesn't truly believe that he's trying to abduct her, so jokingly she tells his to go elsewhere to try and pick up women. Or perhaps it was because she knows he's married and has a family, so for that reason she told him to go out of town? One of the two. She definitely wasn't assisting him with abducting people

She thinks he's trying to "pick up" women (ie consensually have sex with them,) behind his wife's back and that he was reluctant with her once he found out he knew her. She dismissively gave him a location where he could anonymously try to pick up women (not in a helpful way, more in a "I see what you are up to" sense).

Yes, exactly. This combined with his repeated saying he's the only frenchman that hasnt had an affair, establishes that in fact its very common for French men to have a wandering eye. She just suspects hes trying to pick up a random woman for sex and had the bad luck of finding her.
